now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#10
now.text: Daniel Whitehall wants Daisy Johnson, then known as Skye, brought to him, since decades earlier he cut open her mother to steal her youth. Coulson kills him when the team storms his base to get Skye back.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The HYDRA leader who cut open Daisy's mother and wants Daisy brought to him.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Daughter of the woman Whitehall cut open. He wants her brought to him.

proposed.text: Ward brings Daisy Johnson, then known as Skye, to Daniel Whitehall, who decades earlier cut open her mother to steal her youth and now plans the same experiments on her. Coulson kills him when the team storms his base to get Skye back.

changes.evidence: Whitehall never asks for Skye. In Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#9 Ward takes Skye on his own, and Whitehall is surprised and angry that Ward disobeyed orders. In S2#10 Whitehall asks Ward why Skye is there, then tells her he will run on her the same experiments that killed her mother, before Coulson shoots him.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#4
now.text: A close look at May's phone shows Jimmy Woo saved among her contacts, a hint that the two know each other. Nothing more is said or shown.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Jimmy Woo. Saved in May's phone contacts.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent whose phone has Jimmy's number saved.

changes.evidence: The only link is Jimmy Woo's name in May's phone contacts, glimpsed in Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#4. The stage itself says nothing more is said or shown. The two never meet or speak on screen, so the connection is neither explicit nor meaningful, which is the owner's rule.
